AREA&TRAIL

Central Area

The main area of GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort spreads out around Gondola Lift summit station and the rest house "Cheers." There are many well-groomed trails that are perfect for everyone from beginners to advanced skiers.

Central Area Trails

Central Area

GALA's most popular central area has five diverse trails, including a gentle run for beginners, a wide medium-slope trail, and GALA's highest, steepest trail.

"Melody" For  beginner

[350m]

The slope and length are perfect for beginners, allowing you to concentrate on your practice. If you get off chairlift and go straight, you will join the so-called "Uramero" at the bottom of Edelweiss. It is a gentle slope, so it is recommended for first-time skiers.

"Edelweiss" For beginner

[1,600m]

This tree-lined trail is recommended for those who want to ski at a leisurely pace. It's a popular trail for families. There's a detour through the central area. The lower part of the GALA offers a wide, gentle slope, perfect for practice.
*Please be careful as there are U-shaped curves and narrow sections along the way.

"Entertainment"
For beginner&intermediate

[920m]

A long, flat, medium slope. This is the most popular trail in the central area. The trail is wide and open, with few changes in slope, making it suitable for beginners and intermediate skiers.

"Gigi" For intermediate

[1,000m]

A single run where you can enjoy comfortable high-speed turns. This run is very popular among intermediate and advanced skiers. As you go down, the run gets wider, allowing you to enjoy smooth, large turns.

"Grenoble"
For advanced only

[750m]

This steep course continues from the summit, the highest point in GALA, where you can enjoy high-quality snow. You can enjoy the thrill of skiing down the mountain in one go, and in spring it is a famous mogul spot. The starting point has a wonderful view and is a popular photo spot.

NORTH AREA

There are many wide courses, with "Swan" and "Roman Holiday" suitable for beginners, and "Broadway" ideal for intermediate skiers to practice on. There are also off-piste (unpaved) courses for advanced skiers.

North Area Trails

NORTH AREA

The northern area offers a wide range of riding styles, including six trails suitable for beginners to advanced skiers, as well as off-piste terrain and mogul slopes.
This is the entry point for the "Falcon "Down Hill Trail, which offers a 2.5km long run, and the "Roman Holiday" trail, which connects to the Ishiuchi Maruyama Ski Resort.

"Swan" For beginner

[1,050m]

This is a detour trail of Broadway. The entrance is narrow, but the slope is gentle, so even beginners can access the north area. Another great thing about this trail is that you can enjoy the natural terrain on the side. Please enjoy the terrain in a freestyle manner.

"Super Swan" For advanced

[160m]

After heavy snowfall, this off-piste (ungroomed) trail offers powder heaven. It's also a signature trail at Gala where you can enjoy natural moguls. At 33°, it's  steepest trail in GALA for expert-level.

"Broadway" For  intermediate

[700m]

This beautifully groomed trail that perfect for practicing high-speed turns. Broadway is a relatively  comfortoble compared to the central area.

"Super Broadway"
For intermediate to advanced

[450m]

A moderate steep and groomed perfectly. We called hidden gem trail in GALA. *Alpin ski lesson for weekend and public holiday..

"Joanna" For intermediate

［250m］

To the right of Chairlift" Chariot" is exclusively for Ski School lessons. To the left is a short trail, but it is a perfect slope for basic training. If you go to chairlift summit, you will reach the starting point of down hill trail.

"Roman Holiday"
For beginner

[500m]

This course is relatively uncrowded. It's recommended for beginners who want to ski at their own pace. The slope is also ideal for practicing jib tricks!

"Falcon" For intermidiate and advanced

2.5km downhill trail This exhilarating which takes you straight down from the North Area to Ski Center " Cowabunga". The highlight of this trail is undoubtedly the panoramic view of the snow-covered mountains of Minamiuonuma, stretching from the Tanigawa mountain range. Be sure to enjoy a refreshing long cruise while taking in the spectacular scenery.

Terrace, snow play area, observation deck

A new terrace, AMA-TERRACE, has opened at Cheers! Conveniently located with easy access from the gondola, it’s the perfect spot to take a relaxing break between runs.At "Snow Enjoyment Park," which has a hooded snow escalator, you can enjoy sledding comfortably even on snowy days. In addition, there are observation decks with excellent views in the central and northern areas, where you can take commemorative photos with the magnificent view of Yuzawa Town in the background.

Terrace, snow play area, observation deck

Snow Enjoyment Park

Located at the very bottom of the central area, "Snow Enjoyment Park" is a dedicated snow play park separated into a sledding course and an area where you can freely play in the snow.
The sledding course is equipped with a covered snow escalator, allowing you to enjoy sledding comfortably even on snowy days.
The area is surrounded by a net, so even small children can play safely.

Observation deck

GALA YUZAWA has observation decks in both the central and northern areas.
The "Bell of Love Observation Deck" at the top of Barouche Chairlift in the central area can be enjoyed as a sightseeing Chairlift even by those who do not ski or Snowboard.
Please enjoy the breathtaking snowscape.

Bell of Love Observatory

*To reach the Bell of Love observation deck, please take Barouche Chairlift in the central area. *If you have Gondola Pass, you will need a separate Barouche Lift ticket. * Barouche Lift tickets can also be purchased at the information counter inside Gondola Lift Summit Rest House "Cheers".

Yume no Kane Observatory

*To reach the Dream Bell Observation Deck, please take Chariot Chairlift in the North Area. *You cannot ride Chariot Chairlift without wearing skiing equipment.

Notice of complete closure of the South area

For the 2026-2027 winter season, the southern area will be closed.
For more details, please check here.

This is the perfect ticket for enjoying skiing at three different ski resorts.

YUZAWA SNOW LINK

The "YUZAWA SNOW LINK Three-Mountain Common Ticket" allows you to freely move between Yuzawa Kogen, GALA Yuzawa, and Ishiuchi Maruyama ski resorts with a single ticket.
Experience a comfortable and innovative Snow Resort where various ways to enjoy the snow country—skiing, Snowboard, and sightseeing in the snowy mountains—are "linked" together!

Purchase Three Mountains ticket here (External website).

NOTES

■ Sledding is only allowed at sledding trail of " Snow Enjoyment Park"

Sled can be used only sledding trail at "Snow Enjoyment Park."

■ Be careful using mobile phones while riding chairlift / skiing / snowboarding

If you drop your mobile phone under chairlift line or on the trail, WE ARE UNABLE TO FIND ITy.Even you are able to locate where you dropped it, WE WILL REFUSE TO SERCH due to the circumstances. Please do not use your mobile phone while riding chairlift or skiing/snowboarding.Also, please make sure zipped your pockets before go out.

■About riding chairlift while carrying a child on your back or in your arms

When riding with small children who are not wearing ski equipment, parents must take responsibility for securing them with sling or baby carriers, pay attention to safety, and follow the instructions of staff. Also, please ski safely in accordance with the ski resort terms and conditions.

■ Regarding put on ski equipment when riding chairlift and for sightseeing

As a general rule, please put skiing on when riding chairlift. If you have any concerns about riding, please inform a staff member. For sightseeing to the Bell of Love observation deck, only Barouche Chairlift is accessible on foot.

■ Regarding the signs indicating restricted areas at GALA YUZAWA

Due to the risk of avalanches and getting lost, skiing is prohibited in restricted areas. Please do not ski over poles, nets, etc., regardless of the reason.

■ Filming using drones etc. is prohibited

Due to the risk of collisions with skiers or chairlift facilities, or falling, filming using drones or other devices within GALA Yuzawa Ski Resort is prohibited.

■ Walking is prohibited on the trails.

Due to the risk of collision with skiers, walking on the trails for the purposes of climbing or taking photographs is prohibited.

■About the apploved ski equipment

quipment that cannot be secured or attached to the skier or that comes off the feet poses the risk of falling from chairlift or drifting down the course and causing a collision, so it is not permitted to ski or ride chairlift at the ski resort.

Examples of equipment permitted at this ski resort: Skis, Snowboard, chair skis, monoskis, telemark skis, fun skis, separate Snowboard, Bigfoot, Snowfeet

× Examples of equipment that cannot be used at this ski resort: Sled, snow racers, snow bikes (snow scooters, snow motos, snow cycles, SBX), snow skates, airboards

*Please use Sled in areas designated by our company.

*Please contact us if you have any questions regarding the use of other ski equipment than those listed above.

■ Items prohibited from being brought onto Gondola Lift and Chairlift

  • Explosives, flammable liquids (excluding cigarette lighters), explosive substances, corrosive substances, high-pressure gases, substances that may generate toxic gases, etc.
  • Stoves for cooking purposes (electric, gas, portable stoves)
  • Animals (excluding small pet animals without a noticeable odor that are kept in containers and service dogs)
  • Anything that may damage the cabin
  • Items that do not fit inside the cabin
  • Anything other than those listed above, such as sharp objects or items that may cause harm or inconvenience to other passengers

■ If you drop it on the trail

If you drop your smartphone on the trail, you will be responsible for searching for it.

c If you drop your item while riding chairlift or off the trail

If you drop your smartphone while riding chairlift or off the course, please do not try to retrieve it yourself. A patrol member will search for it, so please contact a nearby staff member.

■ Chances of being found

If you drop your smartphone on Trail, the chances of finding it are very low.
If you drop it during snowfall, on an ungroomed course, or off-piste, it's almost impossible to find.

*Even if your smartphone's location information indicates you are on Trail, searching for your equipment may be difficult.
Please be extra careful not to lose anything on Trail, not just your smartphone.
